## Today

`RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.markSegment` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt) already calls `CorrectionFactorCalculator.compute` when closing a RUN segment: it passes the kilometre derived from the segment index, the profile's `correctionFactor` and `expectedDistanceM`, and the segment's measured distance, then appends the outcome — carrying its kilometre — to the race's `retainedFactors` (on `CorrectionFactorOutcome.Retained`) or `rejectedCalibrations` (on `CorrectionFactorOutcome.Rejected`), leaving both unchanged on `NoCandidate`.
